llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The Matcher struct was refactored to use a compiled regex cache to avoid re-compiling regex patterns on each match. The Matches method signature was changed to return a (bool, error) tuple to surface any regex compilation errors. This optimization improves performance for label filtering across the observability stack.

FILES:
- system/pkg/matcher/matcher.go — Update Matcher struct to include regex cache and modify Matches method signature
- system/pkg/matcher/matcher_test.go — Update tests to handle new Matches method signature and error return
- system/pkg/query/parser.go — Update query parser to handle error from Matcher.Matches calls
- system/pkg/alerting/rules.go — Update alerting rule evaluation to handle error from Matcher.Matches calls
